subject: Invite link shortcode breaks passkey/2FA enrollment — LumenWave onboarding
messages:
From: Carlos Moreno <carlos.moreno@lumenwave.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Broken invite flow / shortened link -> passkey enrollment failure

Hi Grace / Ben,

We're trying to finish vendor onboarding for LumenWave. The invite email from Redwood contains a long activation URL which our security filters shorten (we use a gateway that replaces long links with a shortcode like https://l.w/abc123). When recipients click the shortened link on mobile, they get to the portal but the passkey/2FA enrollment step fails with "Invalid token" and the accept button eventually greys out.

We can still accept the PO for now but cannot complete banklink / passkey setup which blocks payments. Can you advise whether Redwood supports a shortcode fallback or a PIN-reset accept flow? Attaching a screenshot from the user flow.

Thanks,
Carlos
Vendor Ops — LumenWave
attachments: screenshot-accept.png (image/png)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Moreno <carlos.moreno@lumenwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-27T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Broken invite flow / shortened link -> passkey enrollment failure

Hi Carlos — thanks for the details and the screenshot.

Quick notes:
- We have observed some link rewriting proxies that strip query fragments or rewrite the token in ways that break the one-time activation token. That matches the "Invalid token" you pasted.
- There is a fallback endpoint we can enable that allows a short numeric PIN to be generated and validated if the primary token fails. It's not enabled by default for Zip/Coupa invites; we usually enable it per-account when customers report gateway rewriting.

Camila — can you check whether the LumenWave invites for this tenant were issued through the standard long-token flow? If so, can you enable the PIN-fallback for the tenant and share the short steps we can send the vendor? I can then patch LumenWave's invite template to avoid link-shortening triggers (wrap in <a> with no trackers).

Carlos — in the meantime, can you confirm whether affected users are clicking from iOS Mail or Android Gmail and whether the click happens on mobile or desktop? That will help prioritize.

Grace
Head of Customer Escalations — Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Moreno <carlos.moreno@lumenwave.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Broken invite flow / shortened link -> passkey enrollment failure

Grace, Ben — I'm looking at the tenant record now (LumenWave tenant id: lw-1382). Initial check: invites were issued with the standard long-token path on 2027-06-26. The token format includes a fragment and a HMAC query param; our render logs show the URL was rewritten by an intermediary host l.w (shortener). I pulled a tiny snippet from the auth service logs showing the token validation path timing out when the fragment is missing — attaching.

Workaround I propose (low risk, quick):
1) Enable PIN-fallback for tenant lw-1382 (generates a 6-digit one-time PIN valid for 30 minutes).
2) Send a short note to the vendor with the PIN entry URL (https://portal.redwood.ai/pin-enter) and the generated PIN.
3) Separately, update the invite template to include the full link as a code block (so gateway scanning doesn't shorten it).

Ben — can you approve enabling PIN-fallback for this tenant? It's a per-tenant flag and requires a short config change and audit entry.

Attachments: render-log-snippet.txt (text/plain)

-Camila
Product Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Moreno <carlos.moreno@lumenwave.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-27T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Broken invite flow / shortened link -> passkey enrollment failure

Thanks — confirmation below:
- Affected users were all on iOS Mail (corporate mailbox enforced by MDM).
- We tried opening the original email on desktop and the flow works there; failure reproduces on mobile only.
- Attached is one full-screen capture showing the "Invalid token" banner + the accept button greyed out.

If you can enable the PIN-fallback that will unblock onboarding for ~8 users today. We can update our gateway to whitelist full links but that will take IT a couple of days.

Appreciate the fast response.

Carlos

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Broken invite flow / passkey/2FA enrollment failure (LumenWave)

Camila / Grace — approved. Camila, please toggle the PIN-fallback for lw-1382 and post an audit note. Also please add a short vendor-facing template we can send to LumenWave explaining how to use the PIN fallback and the recommended mail whitelist.

I've opened INFR-5921 to track the follow-up (platform: consider adding automatic fallback when we detect link rewrite headers). Assign to Platform/Security for triage.

I'll send the PIN to Carlos once you confirm it's live.

Thanks — Ben
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
